title: BALL Wide Mouth Jar 32oz
reviews_5s:
Bought this and on Whole Foods (get them at Whole Foods for less than $3 a pop. I use it for pickling veggies! Love!Left the widemouth jar for all sorts of organizing.Click to play video
I used these for floral arrangements and they were a hit. Now I’ve brought them home and my kids use them as trendy water glasses. Endless possibilities!Love it. I use it to make pickled onions and it’s perfect
reviews_1s: This recent batch has been absolutely terrible!!! I have been buying these for years and love them so much, and we always keep a couple dozen or so in the house at all times. But this recent batch has an issue at the base, a different than normal looking circle and streaks on the bottom of the jar that aren’t shaped like that or look like that on any of the other jars we have from this brand prior. And when hot liquid is added, despite it never being a problems in the dozens of jars before these, now that circle at the base breaks off completely and all the liquid I’ve poured spills out the bottom of the jar - because the entire bottom of the jar literally just breaks off. This is the fourth ball jar we’ve had this issue with now. Hope they notice and fix it soon, because we really need these! But I cannot keep cleaning up glass and unnecessary spills. Our older ball jars do not have this issue at all, so I don’t understand what has changed.If it says "not dishwasher safe" it is not true Ball or Mason brand
